title: Flush pipes and fittings.
officialText:
Flush pipes and fittings shall be of nonferrous material and shall conform to ASME A112.19.5 or
CSA B125.
SECTION PC 426
MANUAL FOOD AND BEVERAGE DISPENSING
EQUIPMENT
